title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
ii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iv.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
seed_phrase: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have ear
